name: Archive Vlog
summary: Turn city and travel clips and photos into a 16:9 cinematic vlog: a letterbox opening with a decoding title, an archived-by credit, a montage cut on the beat and a fade to black, as a new editable Draft.

compatibility.selects: Development build only. Released-version compatibility is unverified. Requires Panel runScript and Draft authoring; no extra tools to install. Windows is built to the kit rules but not yet verified on a real Windows machine.

de.name: Archive Vlog
de.summary: Macht aus Stadt- und Reiseclips und Fotos ein filmisches 16:9-Vlog: ein Letterbox-Auftakt mit sich entschlüsselndem Titel, ein „Archived by“-Credit, eine Montage im Takt und eine Abblende ins Schwarz, als neuen, bearbeitbaren Draft.

ja.name: Archive Vlog

ko.name: Archive Vlog
ko.summary: 도시와 여행 영상, 사진으로 16:9 시네마틱 브이로그를 만듭니다. 레터박스로 열리는 오프닝과 디코딩 타이틀, 'archived by' 크레딧, 비트에 맞춘 몽타주, 검은 화면으로의 페이드아웃까지 편집 가능한 새 Draft로 저장합니다.

pt.name: Archive Vlog

tr.name: Archive Vlog
tr.summary: Şehir ve seyahat kliplerinden ve fotoğraflardan 16:9 sinematik bir vlog oluşturur: çözülerek beliren başlıklı letterbox açılış, “archived by” jeneriği, ritme göre kesilmiş montaj ve siyaha geçiş; düzenlenebilir yeni bir Draft olarak kaydeder.

zh.name: Archive Vlog
zh.summary: 将城市和旅行片段与照片制作成 16:9 电影感 Vlog：遮幅展开的开场与解码式标题、“archived by”署名、卡点蒙太奇和淡出到黑场，并保存为可编辑的新 Draft。

inputs.label: Clips and photos
inputs.hint: City and travel moments: streets, crowds, trams, boats, landmarks, food.
inputs.query: city and travel moments: a street, a crowd, a tram, a boat or a landmark

prepare: City or travel clips and photos, at least 2 different ones, including at least one video
Videos analyzed, so the scene search can find their shots
